back_content.text: 态度：工会接受新技术引入不可避免，但对自动化仍持保留态度；主要担忧是 remote communities 可能受到影响。准确概括是 accepting but concerned，而不是完全支持或完全反对。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Workers unions have accepted the inevitability of the introduction of new technology, but they still have reservations about the rise of automation technology.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：accepted the inevitability 表示承认趋势；but they still have reservations 才标出保留态度；main concern 进一步说明担忧对象。② 核心规律：观点、态度题不能只听到 positive 或 negative 其中一边，要保留“让步 + 转折”的组合态度。③ 验证与纠偏：如果答案写成 fully supportive，就漏掉 reservations；如果写成 totally opposed，又忽略 accepted。
tips: 态度题遇到 accepted...but still...，要把前后两部分合并概括。
reservation / concern 通常表示保留或担忧，不等于彻底反对。

back_content.text: 答案：C。工会承认新技术不可避免，但仍担心自动化消除旧工作后对偏远社区造成影响。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：accepted that the introduction of new technology is inevitable, but still have reservations; main concern is the potential impact on remote communities.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：accepted that...is inevitable 对应“接受趋势”；but still have reservations 对应“仍有保留”；main concern 给出担忧理由。② 干扰项分析：A 漏掉担忧，B 把保留夸大成完全反对，D 与 main concern 直接矛盾。③ 验证与迁移：正确选项必须同时包含 accepting 和 worried 两个方向，不能只抓一个词面。
tips: 四选一态度题优先排除 fully / completely / indifferent 这类绝对化或无关表述。
正确态度通常要覆盖转折前后的完整关系。

front_content.text: 任务：先听音频，复述说话人对“忙碌”的态度变化。
front_content.task_prompt: 任务：先听音频，复述说话人对“忙碌”的态度变化。

task_schema.success_criteria: 能说出说话人从接受忙碌到反对过度忙碌的转变，并指出触发原因

back_content.text: 态度变化：说话人过去被 to-do lists 和 meetings 占满，后来读到 In Praise of Slowness 后意识到 being busy 有害，并开始反抗“过度忙碌”这一观念。核心态度是由习惯性忙碌转向批判和抵制。
back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Then I came across a book... realized that being busy is not only detrimental... I began to revolt against the very idea of being too busy.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号：I once lived with... 描述过去状态；Then I came across... 标出态度转折；realized 与 began to revolt 明确负面评价和行动倾向。② 核心规律：态度变化题要按“过去状态 + 触发事件 + 新态度”整理，不能只摘 busy 或 book。③ 验证与纠偏：detrimental 和 danger 是负向评价，revolt against 表示抵制；答案应写成批判过度忙碌，而不是简单说“他读了一本书”。
tips: Then / realized / began to 这类组合常标出态度变化链。
态度题要把评价词和行动词一起看，判断强度更稳。

audio.transcript: I once lived with a pile of to-do lists and endless work meetings. Then I came across a book called In Praise of Slowness and realized that being busy is not only detrimental, but also has the danger of turning life into an endless race. I began to revolt against the very idea of being too busy.

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Management consultants argue that flexible work arrangements not only boost employee satisfaction but also lead to measurable improvements in productivity and long-term retention rates.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："argue that" = 观点引语动词；not only A but also B = 递进，两个效果均是观点核心。② 核心规律：CET6 专家观点类：argue that + positive outcome = 支持某措施的立场，答案覆盖全部列举效果。③ 验证与迁移：答案双重：employee satisfaction + productivity/retention；只涵盖一项的选项不完整。
tips: argue that = 提出观点（academic register），后接支持某做法的理由。
not only...but also = 两个论点支撑，答案需同时涵盖两点才完整。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Critics of the gig economy contend that its flexibility is largely illusory, masking a fundamentally precarious employment relationship in which workers bear all the financial risk.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："contend that" = 批评者明确立场；"largely illusory" = 批评核心（几乎是假象）；masking = 掩盖真相的动作。② 核心规律：CET6 批评立场：flexibility is illusory/superficial/misleading = 对表面好处的根本否定。③ 验证与迁移：答案方向：speaker/critics believe the flexibility is a false claim hiding real insecurity for workers。
tips: illusory = 假象（ilusión）；masking = 掩盖，是 "看似好但实质坏" 的标准批评用词对。
fundamentally precarious = 从根本上是不稳定的，是批评者对零工经济的核心定性。

back_content.explanation: 语境揭示：Some economists take the view that a degree of income inequality is not only inevitable in a market economy but may actually incentivize innovation and entrepreneurship if managed within reasonable bounds.

analysis_content.text: ① 识别信号："take the view that" = 观点持有动词；"not only inevitable but may actually" = 递进，第二推论是关键；"if managed within reasonable bounds" = 条件限制，说明是有条件的支持。② 核心规律：CET6 有条件支持立场：X is acceptable/beneficial IF Y = 有条件赞同，答案包含条件部分。③ 验证与迁移：答案：economists conditionally support some inequality as potentially beneficial for innovation。
tips: take the view that = 持有某观点（中性引语词），后接该观点内容。
if managed within bounds = 条件子句，是使整个立场成立的关键限定，不可忽略。

fundamentally alter = 从根本上改变，答案含 dramatic/structural/fundamental change方向。
